findings.summary: ChooseBackend falls back to PhysX without checking PhysX is in the build, so the logged warning says 'using physx instead' when nothing will start.
findings.scenario: Build without N2ENGINE_PHYSX_ENABLED, project physics.backend jolt, preset none/authoritative: Init logs 'using physx instead', then the Physics row says built without PhysX; the log contradicts the row (misleading only, no crash).

findings.summary: When the Jolt request comes from the host's ApplicationOptions::JOLT (no project setting), the fallback/refusal message and the Physics row still say 'physics.backend is jolt', naming a project setting the project never set.
findings.scenario: Host passes PhysicsBackend::JOLT, project has no physics.backend: the warning/row blames the project's physics.backend setting, sending the user to a setting that is absent (no host passes JOLT today).
